blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY – The annual three-month closed fishing season for sardines commenced on Sunday across fishing grounds in the Zamboanga Peninsula, a practice now running for 16 years to allow fish stocks to replenish during their peak spawning period. Ahead of the ban, the Department of Agriculture–Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (DA-BFAR) in Region 9 held a send-off ceremony for the closed sardines fishing season on Saturday at the Ben Go Wharf in Barangay Baliwasan Seaside, Zamboanga City. Initiated in 2011, the annual conservation measure prohibits the catching, buying, selling, and transporting of sardines within the East Sulu Sea, Basilan […]...
